title: Predicting Intraocular Pressure From Glaucoma Patients Receiving Medication Treatment Using Explainable Machine Learning.
summary: Explainable machine-learning models estimated intraocular pressure from patient data in glaucoma patients receiving medication treatment. The result is limited to the study cohort and reported evaluation.
ai_technology: Explainable machine-learning models estimate intraocular pressure from glaucoma-patient data during medication treatment.
organization: Departments of Ophthalmology and Radiology, Tech4Health Institute and Neuroscience Institute, New York University Grossman School of Medicine, NYU Langone Health, New York University, New York, New York, USA, nyu.edu

evidence.tested: The full text evaluates estimated intraocular pressure against the reported patient data; cohort/reference details are limited to the study and no external clinical utility is established.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: Explainable machine-learning models estimate intraocular pressure from glaucoma-patient data during medication treatment.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
